checkpoints.statement: Every governed business mutation flows through its owning ServiceOS authority.
ServiceOS contains no model/provider/agent/tool/context/planning AI authority; AI execution is delegated to Zeck.
Tenant ownership is resolved and enforced server-side before domain access or mutation.
ServiceWork state and Zeck Execution state remain separate authorities.
Business external effects use durable intent, authorization, idempotency and observed results.
Material business outcomes have attributable evidence and provenance.
Concurrent/retried durable operations converge without duplicate authority or stale-state mutation.
Frozen architecture changes occur only through ACR and immutable versioning.
An implementation PR changes only its activated Work Order surfaces.
